Billing.title: Lacag-bixinta
Billing.description: Package-kaaga, xogta lacag-bixinta iyo tallaabada xigta - hal meel.
Billing.lockTitle: Tallaabadaada xigta halkan ayay ka bilaabataa.
Billing.lockDescription: Bixi lacagta package-ka laguu qoondeeyey si aad u furato qorshayaasha, kulamada, check-in-ka, horumarka iyo fariimaha coach-ka.
Billing.assignmentHint: Package-ka iyo qiimihiisu halkan ayay kasoo muuqanayaan marka coach-ku kuu qoondeeyo. Inta ka horreysa buuxi profile-kaaga.
Billing.setupPending: Lacag-bixinta online-ka waa la diyaarinayaa. Qaansheegtaadu way kaydsan tahay; soo laabo marka lacag-bixintu diyaar noqoto.
Billing.paymentDetails: Xogta lacag-bixinta waxaad gelinaysaa Sifalo Pay.
Billing.readyTitle: Waxaad diyaar u tahay inaad bilowdo.
Billing.guideTitle: Bixi lacagta si barnaamijkaagu u furmo.
Billing.step1Body: Coach-kaagu wuxuu kuu doortay package. Qiimaha muuqda waa lacagta lagaa rabo muddadan.
Billing.step2Body: Ka dooro adeegyada lacagaha mobile-ka Soomaaliya ama kaarka bangiga ee laga heli karo checkout-ka Sifalo.
Billing.step3Body: Waxaan lacag-bixinta ka xaqiijinaa Sifalo ka hor furitaanka adeegyada. Haddii aad xirto checkout-ka, halkan kusoo laabo si aad u hubiso lacagta.
Billing.renewalBody: Package-ka Monthly wuxuu cusboonaadaa bil kasta; Quarterly-na saddexdii biloodba. Qaansheeg cusub ayaad bixinaysaa si aad u sii wadato. Lacag si otomaatig ah lagaagama jaro.
Billing.welcomeBody: Account-kaagu waa diyaar. Qaad tallaabada xigta ee tababarkaaga.
Billing.profileHint: Ku dar dhererkaaga, miisaanka bilowga iyo xogta caafimaadka si coach-ku kuu caawiyo.
Billing.inactive: Account-ka tababarkaagu ma firfircoona. Coach-kaagu waa inuu dib u hawlgeliyaa ka hor lacag-bixinta iyo furitaanka barnaamijka.
Billing.connectionError: Xiriirkii ayaa go?ay. Hubi xaaladda lacag-bixinta ka hor intaadan isku dayin mar kale.
Billing.successBody: Lacag-bixinta {name} waa la xaqiijiyey. Program-kaaga iyo adeegyada tababarka hadda way kuu furan yihiin.
